thread:
maria: Quick sync — customers asking for a compact observability surface for Console v2. Main asks: dashboard templates, cheap tracing hooks, cost breakdown per-route, and an error analytics rollup.
ashok: +1. Need to confirm what 'cheap tracing hooks' means for infra. Do they want sampling, or lightweight span tags?
kelly: From customers: 1) per-route cost % broken down by model + tokens, 2) top error reasons with example requests (sanitized), 3) small set of UI templates for common slices.
nate: For rollout we should define launch gates. My proposal: "MVP" = dashboards + per-route cost; "MVP+" = add tracing hooks (sampling + error spans) and error analytics.
maria: Acceptance criteria idea:
- Dashboards: 3 templates (cost, latency, error-rate) with default filters for Org/Route/Model.
- Cost: token + inference time breakdown, UI tab with filterable table and CSV export.
- Tracing hooks: SDK flag `obs.light` to enable minimal spans (name, route, model, error_code) with default 1% sampling.
- Error analytics: aggregate top 10 root causes by normalized stack (no raw PII), ability to open a sample request with redaction.
ashok: Tech notes: `obs.light` should be routed through our existing tracing lib. We'll need an opt-in at route-config layer and a fallback to no-op for Dedicated/Private unless customer toggles. Also need quotas to avoid token leaks when returning sample requests.
kelly: UX asks: allow customers to pin templates, save filter sets, and toggle sampling rate slider (0-10%). Keep default conservative.
maria: Risk/ops: exposing sample requests might be a compliance hole. We'll require automatic redaction and an audit log entry per sample export. Add KBA: "When you toggle sampling, an audit event is logged".
observability-bot: Deploy checklist created: `gh:obs/console-lite-checklist` with items for dashboards, cost endpoint, tracing-flag, redaction pipeline.
nate: Timeline suggestion: 3 sprints for MVP (dashboards + cost endpoint + CSV), then 2 sprints for tracing hooks + error analytics pilot with 2 beta customers.
ashok: Engineering asks: need one infra ticket to support per-route cost attribution: collect `route_id`, `model_id`, `token_in/out`, and `gpu_time_ms` into the metrics pipeline. This should be additive to existing telemetry.
kelly: Product tradeoffs to call out in PRD: sampling increases operational cost and complexity; CSV export gives customers something immediately useful but we must throttle exports.
maria: Customer-driven prioritization: if a customer commits to Dedicated/Reserved in next 90d, we prioritize their custom dashboard and higher sampling rate in their tenancy. Otherwise feature stays in hosted quotas.
nate: Launch gating checklist (proposed):
- Data quality: per-route cost within 5% of billing estimates
- Security: exported samples redacted + KMS policy verified
- Observability: dashboard refresh <= 15s for typical orgs (100 routes)
- Ops: fallback plan if tracing causes load spike (auto-disable on CPU/GPU > 80%)
kelly: Can we add a lightweight demo flow for sales: 2-min video showing pinning template + downloading CSV + sample error view? Sales asked for that.
maria: Good call — add 'sales demo' to launch tasks. Also need one pager for enterprise about sampling controls and compliance.
ashok: Heads-up: infra slot for `per-route` metric pipeline will be a blocker if not scheduled early. I'll file the ticket and tag SRE.
maria: Ok next steps: ashok to sketch tech design + scoped infra effort by EOD Fri. kelly to draft PRD acceptance criteria and UX mocks. nate to assemble rollout timeline and beta customer list. I'll consolidate into PRD draft next week. :thumbsup:
